name: adbc
description: Stored credentials and connection details for ADBC drivers. Reference a secret by name in `adbc_connect`, or rely on `SCOPE`-based URI lookup so the right secret is selected automatically when its scope prefix matches the connection URI.

parameters.name: driver
parameters.description: ADBC driver name (e.g. `'sqlite'`, `'postgresql'`) or path to a shared library.

parameters.name: uri
parameters.description: Connection URI passed to the driver. Driver-specific format.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Database password. Automatically redacted in logs.

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: Database name, when not encoded in the URI.

parameters.name: entrypoint
parameters.description: Custom driver entrypoint function name (rarely needed).

examples.description: PostgreSQL with credentials and a SCOPE for auto-lookup
examples.code:
CREATE SECRET my_postgres (
  TYPE adbc,
  SCOPE 'postgresql://prod-server:5432',
  driver 'postgresql',
  uri 'postgresql://prod-server:5432/mydb',
  username 'app_user',
  password 'secret_password'
);

examples.description: Use the secret explicitly by name
Auto-lookup — DuckDB picks the secret whose SCOPE matches the URI

examples.code:
CREATE PERSISTENT SECRET my_postgres (
  TYPE adbc,
  SCOPE 'postgresql://prod-server:5432',
  driver 'postgresql',
  uri 'postgresql://prod-server:5432/mydb',
  username 'app_user',
  password 'secret_password'
);
